notes.title: Sakura Sakura Available November 19th!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31889187/2bffc99b374d9690cd06bb5b4ae69cb3d725145b.png[/img]

[h1]Available November 19th[/h1]

After a long and difficult production cycle, we've finally completed Sakura Sakura! We're super excited for everyone who will be able to experience this wonderful game, and we really hope you do!

[b]Sakura Sakura[/b] will be available starting [b]November 19th at 10:00 AM PST[/b]!

Sincerely,
The Sol Press Team
